cat > /workdir/play.py <<'PY'
import arena,subprocess,re,sys,chess,time
n=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1
secs=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 90
for i in range(n):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 legal=[]
 for m in b.legal_moves:
  b.push(m); isdraw=arena.result(b)=='1/2-1/2';b.pop()
  if not isdraw:legal.append(m.uci())
 cmd=['./think',b.fen(),str(secs)]
 if legal:cmd+=[' '.join(legal)]
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
 print('\n'.join(r.stdout.splitlines()[-5:]),flush=True)
 m=re.search('bestmove (\w+)',r.stdout).group(1)
 print('PLAY',m,flush=True)
 arena.cmd_move(m)
 print('',flush=True)
 if arena.result(arena.load_board()):break
PY
